meta.title: GalTransl Presets (Coder / Translator)
meta.description: Two dsh presets for GalTransl: galtransl-coder works as both translator and programmer and may use the generic file tools to read and write code and docs; galtransl is a translator-only assistant that never volunteers program changes and has no file, shell, or web tools. Both mount the GalTransl MCP tools (23) plus serial subagents.
